name: @vaipakam/lib
description: Framework-agnostic shared utilities consumed by every app in the monorepo (apps/app, apps/www, apps/agent, apps/indexer, apps/keeper). Stage 2a scope: multicall (viem helpers), decodeContractError (error normaliser), chainPlatforms (chainId → CoinGecko platform slug), canonicalAssets (per-chain ERC-20 lists), crossDomainPref (parent-domain cookie helper for preference sync across the two surfaces; LANGUAGE-only in practice today — the connected app does not read the theme cookie, see the note in packages/lib/README.md). format + journeyLog are deferred until their Vite-coupled deps (i18n, contracts/config) are extracted.
